information_directed_program.frontier_owner: alpha_agent.r63.gaps (information_gap_frontier.json) read through alpha_agent.r59.information_needs with the R64 overlay
information_directed_program.governor_proof: alpha_agent.r59.governor.generate_mandates is run against an ISOLATED research memory under the campaign root (PAPER_TRADER_R59_RESEARCH_ROOT redirected), with an empty scope view so only information-need mandates are offered; the executed families must map to mandated or top-ranked needs and the mapping is published
information_directed_program.non_price_rule: >= 75 % of newly executed autonomous specifications target non-exhausted information needs rather than PRICE_STATE transformations
information_directed_program.reopening_rule: an exhausted PRICE_STATE family reopens only for genuinely new orthogonal information, materially improved PIT history or coverage, or a truly distinct economic implementation resolving a NAMED binding failure; the cross-asset TREND cadence cells reopen under the last clause (R64 named 'daily cadence cost drag' as the binding failure) and are counted as PRICE_STATE

intraday_axis.futures_panel: DATA_INSUFFICIENT at 49 sessions; the floor is not moved and the family is not opened
intraday_axis.gates_frozen: materiality >= 1.5 %/yr, NW t >= 2.0, BH q = 0.10, family Holm alpha = 0.05, >= 36 effective periods, halves floor -0.005, PLUS survival at the 5.0 bp stress cost and positive equal-risk incremental utility
intraday_axis.turnover_gate_substitution: GATE_MAX_TURNOVER is a daily-book gate every intraday strategy exceeds by construction; replaced by charging the full round trip every session at three rates - stricter, not weaker
intraday_axis.window_exchange_local: 09:30-11:59 ET, 150 minutes, complete on all 500 sessions

market_direction.features: price state (21-, 63-session return, 252-21 trend, 21/252 vol ratio, 252-session drawdown), VOLATILITY_EXPECTATIONS_IV, CREDIT_CONDITIONS, TERM_STRUCTURE, RATES_EXPECTATIONS, INFLATION_EXPECTATIONS, FUNDING_LIQUIDITY_CONDITIONS, MACRO_CHANGE, MACRO_SURPRISES, RISK_APPETITE from alpha_agent.r63.features.market_conditioner_blocks (PIT by declared lag / vintage), plus CFTC ES speculative net positioning (6-day publication lag)
metrics: Brier score and Brier skill score against climatology
calibration bins (10) and expected calibration error
realised OOS return by forecast tercile
economic: overlay A (hold SPY when p >= training base rate, else cash) and overlay B (exposure = clip(p / base rate, 0, 1)) at 1bp per side versus buy-and-hold; paired Newey-West t

models.climatology: training base rate (the honest no-information baseline)
models.expected_return: ridge regression on the same features; uncertainty = training residual standard deviation
models.probability: L2-regularised logistic regression on training-standardised features, penalty by blocked inner CV on log loss, refit on R63 yearly expanding folds with purge and embargo, lockbox 2023+

market_direction.target: SPY total return (owned Norgate, 1993-), the canonical US equity market target

verdicts.CALIBRATED_DIRECTIONAL_SKILL: Brier skill > 0 with Newey-West t >= 2 on per-period Brier differences AND expected calibration error <= 0.05 AND >= 60 % of yearly folds with positive skill
verdicts.CALIBRATED_NOT_PROFITABLE: calibration passes but no overlay beats buy-and-hold
verdicts.PROFITABLE_NOT_CALIBRATED: an overlay beats buy-and-hold net with t >= 2 but the calibration condition fails

options_surface_axis.horizon_21_not_run: ~12 non-overlapping periods against the frozen floor of 36
options_surface_axis.outcome: DATA_INSUFFICIENT - only 25 of 264 dates carry a near-dated expiry whose strikes bracket the money; no cell scored, no threshold moved
options_surface_axis.resolves_named_binding_failure: VOLATILITY|TS|21|VOLATILITY_EXPECTATIONS_IV returned DATA_HOLD on 196 rows against sensitivity.MIN_ROWS = 200 and its cadence answer failed reproduction; both attempts used an INDEX PROXY

purchase_case.news_audit: a bounded READ-ONLY depth probe of the entitled EODHD news endpoint (a handful of symbols, historical from/to windows, one delisted ticker) measures history depth and survivorship coverage before any acquisition is planned
purchase_case.rule: no purchase, subscription, trial or account during the campaign; information need first, provider second; every paid candidate carries the R63 break-even arithmetic (fee / NAV + trading cost by horizon + half the expected gross increment + 10 % of fee / NAV) against the live paper NAV read from the desk ledger; BUY_TEST only when the expected incremental net P&L exceeds the break-even alpha after the haircut

question: Does any specification built from OWNED or FREE information materially beat fundamental_momentum_50_50_v1 after realistic costs on an identical sample (or add incremental utility to the incumbent-only portfolio under equal risk), strongly enough to enter governed TRUE_FORWARD competition within ten eligible sessions - and if not, exactly which information is missing and what would it cost to buy?
registration_rule: Every family, specification budget, horizon, target, construction, gate, threshold, cadence grid, calibration test and verdict rule below was written BEFORE any campaign number was computed. Nothing here may be edited after a result is observed. A hypothesis that occurs to the researcher after seeing results is registered as a NEW protocol version with an explicit disclosure of what had already been seen. Thresholds are inherited from the existing owners (R57/R58/R59/R63/R64) and may not be relaxed.

budget.why: a confirmation that can be re-run with a different parameter is not a confirmation

discovery_sample.why: the sign was read off this sample, so every statistic computed on it - the holdout and the holdout halves included - is conditioned on that choice. It sizes the hypothesis and cannot test it.

independent_historical_confirmation.acquisition: $3.3539 for 24 monthly bands plus $0.0261 for SPY marks; zero paid dollars
independent_historical_confirmation.no_new_threshold: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is decided by the existing MIN_EFFECTIVE_PERIODS floor of 36; pass and fail are decided by the existing options_surface gates
independent_historical_confirmation.why_one: one hypothesis, frozen in advance, tested once on a window chosen before it was measured - which is exactly what a pre-registration buys and why no second arm may ever be added

true_forward.backfill: NONE - the first legitimate observation is the first eligible session STRICTLY AFTER registration

reversed_sign_challenger.why_it_exists: the PUT_CALL_SKEW sign was pre-registered from theory as +1 and the data contradicted it at h=1 and h=5. The contradicted direction is not adoptable on the sample that suggested it and is not discardable either, so it is FROZEN as a hypothesis and submitted only to evidence that did not choose it.

what_this_campaign_is_not: not a release: progress is measured by the scoreboard, never by lines, tests or release numbers

not a second scorer, PIT engine, book, frontier, memory, queue, scheduler or forward owner: alpha_agent.r63.sensitivity.run_cell, alpha_agent.r63.pit, alpha_agent.r64.construction, alpha_agent.r63.gaps, alpha_agent.r59.information_needs and api.forward_challenger_registry stay canonical
not a live change: no merge, deploy, restart, registration, adoption, promotion, approval, order, fill, purchase, subscription, trial, account or live-store write
not a transformation zoo: another lag, transform, normalisation, tree or parameter reopens nothing
